title: Exercise before work or after work: which suits you better?
intro: The best time to exercise is the time you can repeat every week. Morning or evening, both can help you lose weight as long as you're consistent and eat in a controlled way.

sections.p: Results come from your total exercise in a week, not a specific hour. Choose the time with the fewest 'distractions' in your life. If one time doesn't work, try another without feeling like you've failed.

The advantage is your workout is done before work and meetings start attacking. The challenge is you need to sleep earlier so you don't sacrifice sleep. Suitable for those who like an early routine or whose evenings are often unpredictable.

Your body is usually warmer and many people feel stronger in the evening. Exercise can also be a way to release stress from work and traffic. The challenge is overtime or tiredness can make you skip, so plan ahead.

If you exercise in the morning, a light snack like a banana or a slice of bread can help if you feel weak. If you exercise in the evening, have a small snack about 1 to 2 hours before, for example yogurt or fruit. After your workout, eat a normal meal that has protein.

If you WFH, use the time you used to spend commuting for a 20-minute workout. If you do field work, walking and physical activity during work also count. Add short strength workouts 2 to 3 times a week.

action: Try exercising in the morning 2 times and in the evening 1 time this week, then see which is easier.
Prepare your workout clothes the night before.
If you exercise in the evening, keep your gym bag in the car so you go straight after work.
Plan a small snack before your workout so you're not starving afterwards.
myth: Some say exercising in the morning on an empty stomach burns more fat. In reality, for weight loss, what matters more is how much you eat and move over the whole day and week, not whether your stomach is empty or not.

faq.q: Does exercising at night affect sleep?
faq.a: For most people it's not a problem. If you find it hard to sleep, try finishing intense workouts about 2 hours before bed.

faq.q: Can I exercise during my lunch break?
faq.a: Yes. A 15-minute walk or a short circuit helps too. Choose something that won't make you sweat too much if you need to go back for a meeting.

faq.q: Can I exercise during my period?
faq.a: Many women can, and light exercise sometimes even helps you feel more comfortable. Listen to your body, lower the intensity if needed, and see a doctor if you have severe pain or a condition like PCOS.
